dispatch-control-reverse.scope: Same-implementation diagnostic comparison; does not replace acceptance reference

interpretation: The unchanged installed package dispatches main_subgroup despite an explicit main graph operation: the declared path is absent from RMSNorm options. This also occurs on cached dispatches.

The separately identified source repair propagates the path and dispatches main with the original shader bytes in both physical directions. All 196 repaired calls match their graph, including 188 cache hits.

The repaired same-Mac control fails 16/55 against the frozen reference; therefore changes against that reference include effects of entry-point correction. This does not replace or invalidate the unchanged acceptance gate.

Cross-platform differences remain with the same repaired implementation: 21/55 forward and 1/55 reverse exceed 0.001 against the same-Mac control. These diagnostic comparisons do not replace the original acceptance failures.
No arithmetic fix or immutable replacement package is accepted. The missing-piece failure and public P2P acceptance remain separate work.

reproduce.reference: Use the frozen reference identified by comparisons[*].referenceSha256; never overwrite it.
reproduce.candidate: Add DOPPLER_DISPATCH_SOURCE_ROOT=<doppler-checkout>/src. Use DOPPLER_DISPATCH_PLACEMENT=linux-mac and mac-linux serially. Do not set DOPPLER_DISPATCH_RMSNORM_SOURCE.
reproduce.numerics: Use default observation mode and all reference prompts. Compare with node tests/fixtures/compare-normalization-captures.js <reference.json> <capture.json> <comparison.json>. Exit 1 preserves numerical failures.
reproduce.control: DOPPLER_DISPATCH_PLACEMENT=mac-mac runs both repaired partitions on the same Mac as a separate diagnostic control.
